title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened its efforts to promote the participation of adolescents and young people in the realization of their rights. ACO deepened its collaboration with youth organizations and CSO that fostered meaningful adolescent engagement. Participation in the programming cycle was enhanced through the involvement of the Adolescent Council (CAU) in the evaluation of the CPD and the dissemination of strategic content. U-Report amplified the voices of adolescents, offering chatbot-based access to information on misinformation and mental health. Within MUNA initiative, 37 municipalities received support to promote adolescent participation in local policies. 18,025 young people were engaged in meaningful participation strategies.
